correctness.rationale: For a successor-commuting map, periodic core must map to target cycle, forcing target length d dividing source c and exactly d rotations. A source leaf has options one forced predecessor core point plus target leaves in its fibre. Inclusion-exclusion gives Q_{p,q} for occupied target leaves and independent fibres multiply, proving Hom polynomial. Idempotence forces identity core shift and fixes each occupied leaf, giving ∏ sum binom(s_i,j)(j+1)^(s_i-j)u^j. Reflecting fibre indices with a->-a preserves E and I; directed-core isomorphisms are only cyclic rotations, so (1,2,3) and (1,3,2) differ. Independently computed E and I arrays and totals 1968 and 276; algebra inverse-image has 2^(d+k) elements, not d+k.
